description_en: Queries the attack events launched against a website
description_zh: 查询针对网站业务的攻击事件
name: DescribeDomainAttackEvents

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.

This UNIX timestamp must indicate a point in time that is accurate to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website.

A forwarding rule must be configured for the domain name. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html operation to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. For example, to query the returned results on the first page, set the value to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询请求时返回的页码。例如，查询第一页的返回结果，则填写1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.name: page_size

DomainAttackEvents.description_en: An array that consists of the details of the DDoS attack event
DomainAttackEvents.description_zh: 网站业务DDoS攻击事件信息

EndTime.description_en: The time when the DDoS attack stopped. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
EndTime.description_zh: 攻击结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒

StartTime.description_en: The time when the DDoS attack started. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds
StartTime.description_zh: 攻击开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of returned DDoS attack events
